answers.reason: The junior professor holds no office giving a seat in the senate.
Budget planning involves higher office holders due to university-wide planning.
Professors are typically included in appointment committees, but rank rules apply; as a professor, they are eligible.
Faculty councils include faculty members holding office or rank like professors.
Professors participate in faculty teaching and study matters.
Examination boards deal with specific student matters handled by designated offices.
Junior professors lead research groups and participate in research funding.
Junior professors teach and are involved in programme module revisions.
Laboratory equipment procurement is specific to teaching labs rather than general professorial duties.
Orientation week planning is typically organized for and by students or specific administrative roles.
